title: fix(news): ignore live health stats in the weekly model post
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The weekly model news comparison now ignores live health stats alongside description and added_date, so changes to status, success rate, or request count alone do not count as model changes. In a preview of the same week, the comparison sent to the writer fell from 623 kB to 305 kB and the changed-model count fell from 257 to 105; the Discord post still had six sections. A test confirms that a week with only health changes saves a snapshot without creating a post.
